legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access COMPARE › CROWMARK VS SWIFTBID HONEST COMPARISON CrowMark vs SwiftBid Pay per bid, or subscribe. Which model fits depends on how often you bid. Every competitor figure is sourced and dated. Updated 26 July 2026 CrowMark is a subscription UK bid and tender management suite from £49 per month. SwiftBid is a per-bid AI writing service, charged at £149 to £749 a bid with no subscription. They price in completely different ways, so the honest comparison is about how often you bid and what you need around the draft. This page sets out both, states CrowMark's prices, and dates every source. At a glance CrowMark compared with SwiftBid across model, features and pricing FEATURE CROWMARK SWIFTBID Category UK bid and tender management suite (subscription) Per-bid AI bid-writing service Pricing model Subscription from £49/month Per bid: £149 / £349 / £749 UK tender discovery (Contracts Finder + Find a Tender) Yes, refreshed daily at 06:00 None; you upload contract packs Drafting grounded in your own answer library Yes Per-bid AI drafting from documents you supply Human expert review Software only; your own reviewer approves each draft Optional at Premium tier Figure-grounding (AI blocked from inventing a number) Yes, deterministic gate Not stated publicly PPN 017 AI-use disclosure on every draft Yes Not stated publicly PPN 002 social value (10% floor) Yes, deterministic Not stated as a dedicated calculation Post-award delivery evidence (Procurement Act 2023 s.52 / s.71) Yes Not stated Fastest turnaround Continuous access, draft any time As fast as 6 hours (Premium) Best for Suppliers bidding regularly, across sectors Firms doing 1 to 4 bids a year, no subscription What is SwiftBid? SwiftBid is a per-bid AI bid-writing service. Rather than a subscription, you pay for each bid at one of three fixed prices: £149 for Basic, £349 for Standard and £749 for Premium. The Premium tier adds optional human expert review, a compliance audit, multi-document analysis and turnarounds as fast as six hours. It is sector-agnostic and has no built-in tender discovery feed; you upload the contract pack you want written against. For a firm that bids only once or twice a year, that model has a real advantage: no ongoing commitment, and at Premium the option of a human reviewer on the draft. CrowMark does not offer either of those. If your bidding is genuinely occasional, paying per bid can be the cheaper and simpler choice, and SwiftBid is built around exactly that. What is CrowMark? CrowMark is CrowAgent's UK bid and tender management suite. It is a subscription, which gives you continuous access to tender discovery, drafting, social-value scoring and delivery evidence rather than a per-bid transaction. It tracks Contracts Finder and Find a Tender, refreshed every morning at 06:00, and drafts answers cited to the regulations, to the tender's own clauses and to the supplier's answer library. Its defining rule is figure-grounding: before a draft is shown, every £ and % is checked against a set of allowed figures computed from your own data, and if a number is not in that set the draft is rejected. Every AI-assisted draft carries a PPN 017 AI-use disclosure and waits for a person to approve it. The answer library in CrowMark, shown with a sample account. It is the store a subscription builds up bid after bid, which the drafter then grounds new answers in. CrowMark also calculates PPN 002 social value deterministically against the 10% minimum weighting, and after award it tracks each commitment to a delivery percentage with a RAG status, captures evidence, issues monthly reports and checks the Procurement Act 2023 KPI duties in sections 52 and 71. It does not supply an external bid writer; the reviewer who approves each draft is your own. CrowMark publishes its pricing. Starter is £49 per month for 3 users, Pro is £149 per month for 10 users with post-award delivery tracking, and Portfolio is contact sales. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial. Pricing compared The maths comes down to volume. SwiftBid Standard at £349 a bid costs about £1,047 for three bids in a year. A CrowMark Starter subscription is £49 per month, or £529 for a year on annual billing, which covers as many bids as you want to write in that time. So for one or two bids a year SwiftBid can be cheaper, and from roughly the third bid of the year a CrowMark subscription tends to win on cost, before you even count the tender discovery, social-value maths and delivery evidence that come with it. Which should you choose? Choose SwiftBid if You bid only once or twice a year and do not want a subscription. You want the option of a human expert reviewing a one-off, high-stakes bid. You already know which tender you are bidding and just need the draft written. A fixed price per bid is easier for you to approve than a monthly plan. Choose CrowAgent (CrowMark) if You bid regularly and want continuous access rather than paying per bid. You need Contracts Finder and Find a Tender discovery refreshed daily. You want the AI blocked from inventing a figure, with a PPN 017 disclosure on every draft. You need deterministic PPN 002 social value maths and post-award delivery evidence. Where CrowMark loses honestly For genuinely occasional bidders, SwiftBid's per-bid model is the more sensible spend: no subscription, a fixed cost per bid, and at Premium the option of a human expert on the draft, which CrowMark's self-serve software does not provide. If you write one bid this year and none next year, a monthly subscription is poor value and SwiftBid is the honest recommendation. CrowMark earns its keep when bidding is a regular activity, and when tender discovery, deterministic social-value maths and post-award delivery evidence are worth having in one place. The two can also be combined: subscribe to CrowMark for the ongoing work and commission SwiftBid for a single high-stakes bid. Frequently asked questions Is CrowMark or SwiftBid cheaper? Does SwiftBid have a subscription? Does SwiftBid find tenders for me? Does SwiftBid include a human bid writer? How fast is each one? Which handles social value and post-award delivery? I only bid once or twice a year, which is better? Can I use both CrowMark and SwiftBid? Sources SwiftBid per-bid pricing (£149 Basic, £349 Standard, £749 Premium), no tender discovery feed, optional human expert review and 6-hour turnaround at Premium, and target of 1 to 4 bids a year. These figures are reported by a dated third-party comparison; SwiftBid does not publish an equivalent primary pricing page we could verify directly.
